summary.description:
Today, a bit warmer for the feels like temperature (up 1.6°C) and more moisture-laden outside humidity (up 12%).

Compared to today, yesterday also had noticeable differences in cloud levels (up 1584 m).

The past week and month had observable variation in cloud levels (up 970 m) and light levels (up 4071 lux) when compared to today.
